chose: D15's big moments, the ones shown dimmed when no bite was said about them, are decided per catalog moment in one total table (BIG_MOMENTS, Record<Moment, boolean>): a try (it follows every touchdown), a lead change, a turnover, a big play and an onside kick are big; every other moment, a kick included, is not. A bite covers every moment of the play home matched it to (by play id); a bite home hasn't matched covers none. The game's moment log is one family with "just happened": both read the same entry (momentEntryOf), and the phone, not home, decides which entries are big, so home serves the log and no policy.
options: Scores, turnovers, big plays and onside kicks, per moment (chosen): the issue's "scoring plays, turnovers, big plays", read off the catalog's closed union so a new moment must be decided here.
Count a kick as big too: catches field goals, but every punt would show dimmed as a gap.
Every moment the engine read: the whole game greyed out, so a real gap is lost among third downs and snaps.
Have home mark which moments are big: puts a phone-screen policy on the server, and a second reading of the log would need a second flag.
gray: Which moments count as a gap worth seeing is a judgement of what the owner wants to have reacted to; the issue names the categories, not the catalog's moments, and field goals fall between them because the catalog's kick moment is also every punt.
